info.name: Look up whether a user is known to Trustly

params.name: externalId
params.description: Your external identifier for the Customer.

params.name: phone
params.description: User's phone number in ITU E.164 format.

items.docs:
Checks whether a user has previously used Trustly, based on one or more provided identifiers (email, phone, or your own customer ID).

Merchants can use this endpoint without having to launch Trustly widget/lightbox. One such use case could be to use this endpoint early in the payment funnel — before the user reaches the payment selection screen — to determine whether to surface Trustly as the top payment option.
